summary: Part 1 of 1 of the Revibe training video '9.0 Seller agreement (Seller & KAMs)', 03:45 long. There is no live app: the trainer walks through the Revibe Seller Agreement as a document viewer, highlighting clauses while speaking. Topics: the deal (commission model, price lists, no direct customer contact), order shipping deadlines and penalties, weekly payments and bank-account rules, required documents, VAT scheme choice, product grades and battery limits, returns and warranty, dispute timelines, shipping and packing duties, the score and exit terms. It ends on a recap slide that points to the Key Account Manager for questions. All 27 frames were opened; frame t00000 is black and the title card first appears at t00001.

facts.statement: If the phone shows a message that the battery or other parts are not original, the customer is entitled to a full refund.

evidence.quote: A non-original parts message means a full refund.
'If the phone displays a message indicating that the battery or any other parts are not original, the customer is entitled to a full refund.'

facts.statement: The screen is covered by Revibe's warranty and returns policy if there are no signs of physical breakage caused by the customer. For suspected physical damage, the Seller must provide clear pictures or videos showing the breakage; this applies to returns and warranties.

evidence.quote: '7.3 Screen Coverage: ... In cases of suspected physical damage, the Seller must provide clear pictures or videos showing the breakage to substantiate the claim. This policy applies to both returns and warranties.'

facts.statement: If a laptop arrives with the wrong specifications, such as a keyboard layout different from the order (e.g. English instead of Arabic), Revibe may fully refund the customer if the Seller refuses to rectify it.

evidence.quote: '7.5 Laptops - Incorrect Device or Keyboard Layout ... Revibe reserves the right to fully refund the customer (in case the Seller refuses to rectify the issue).'

facts.statement: LCD issues are not covered under warranty after 6 months from the delivery date.

evidence.quote: '7.6 LCD Coverage - LCD issues are not covered under warranty after 6 months from the delivery date.'

facts.statement: For every Order dispatched, the Seller must record clear visual proof (photos or video) of the device's condition at packing and dispatch; this proof is a precondition to raising any later claim about the device's condition.

evidence.quote: Most important, film every device when you pack it and record an unpacking video for every return.
Without this proof, you can't dispute a claim.
'a) Outbound shipments. For every Order dispatched ... clear visual proof (photographs or video) ... Such proof shall be a precondition to raising any subsequent claim'

facts.statement: For every device returned in a return or warranty claim, the Seller must record an unpacking video on receipt; that video is the supporting evidence for any claim the Seller raises on that device.

evidence.quote: record an unpacking video for every return.
'b) Returns and warranty cases. Upon receipt of any device returned ... the Seller shall record an unpacking video ... Such video shall constitute the supporting evidence'

facts.statement: For UAE and South Africa orders, if the Seller has produced the evidence required under 7.7(a) and (b), Revibe bears the cost of the relevant shipment.

evidence.quote: 'c) Shipment costs — UAE and ZA. ... and provided the Seller has produced the evidence required under paragraphs (a) and (b) above, Revibe shall bear the cost of the relevant shipment.'

facts.statement: For KSA (Saudi) orders, the Seller bears the cost of the relevant shipment.

evidence.quote: 'd) Shipment costs — KSA. For Orders shipped to the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), the Seller shall bear the cost of the relevant shipment.'

facts.statement: A claim is valid if the Seller agrees the defect is valid, or if the Seller disagrees but Revibe reviews the case and confirms the defect is valid. Revibe's decision is final.

evidence.quote: '8.1 Valid and Invalid Claims: A claim is considered valid if: the Seller agrees the defect is valid; or the Seller disagrees, but Revibe reviews the case and confirms the defect is valid. Revibe's decision is final.'
If you disagree with a claim, Revive reviews it and its decision is final.

facts.statement: A claim is invalid if the Seller states the defect is invalid and Revibe, after review, confirms the claim is invalid. Revibe's decision is final.

evidence.quote: 'A claim is considered invalid if: the Seller states the defect is invalid; and Revibe, after review, confirms that the claim is invalid. Revibe's decision is final.'

facts.statement: The Clause 7.7 evidence requirements apply in every valid or invalid claim case.

evidence.quote: 'In all cases, the evidentiary requirements set out in Clause 7.7 shall apply.'

facts.statement: Customers may return a device within 15 days of delivery for any valid reason, including change of mind or product issues.

evidence.quote: Customers can return a device within 15 days for any reason.
'The acceptance of returns within 15 days from the delivery date for any valid reason, including change of mind or product issues.'

facts.statement: If a customer raises a second valid issue on the same order, the Seller must accept the return on the customer's request even if the 15-day period has expired.

evidence.quote: 'If a second claim is raised by the customer for the same order and for a second valid issue, the Seller shall be required to accept the return upon the customer's request, even if the 15-day period has expired.'

facts.statement: UAE and South Africa orders, customer does not accept (change of mind or refusal): the product returns to the Seller, Revibe handles the shipping costs, no deduction is made, and the Seller is credited 100% of the SKU price initially indicated.

evidence.quote: Change of mind or refuse delivery.
Revive covers shipping and you're paid in full.

'AE & ZA Orders — The product is returned to the Seller, Revibe handles the shipping costs internally, and no deductions will be made from the Seller for returns due to a change of mind. The Seller is credited 100% of the SKU price they initially indicated.'

facts.statement: Saudi (KSA) orders, customer does not accept (change of mind or refusal): the product returns to the Seller, the Seller pays the shipping costs, no deduction is made for change of mind, and the Seller is credited 80% of the SKU price initially indicated minus AED 150. The Seller keeps the device plus 20% of the SKU price plus AED 150.

evidence.quote: Accept refused Saudi orders.
You get the device back, plus 20% of the price and 150 dirhams.

'SA Orders — ... The Seller handles the shipping costs ... The Seller is credited 80% of the SKU price they initially indicated minus 150 AED meaning the Seller keeps the device + 20% of the SKU price they initially indicated plus 150 AED.'

facts.statement: Worked example from the agreement for a KSA customer refusal with an SKU price of AED 1,000: Revibe recovers AED 650 (80% x 1,000 - 150), and the Seller keeps the returned device plus AED 350 (20% x 1,000 + 150).

evidence.quote: 'For an Order with an SKU price of AED 1,000: Revibe recovers AED 650 (i.e. 80% × 1,000 – 150). The Seller retains the returned device plus AED 350 (i.e. 20% × 1,000 + 150).'

facts.statement: Seller-issue return for UAE and South Africa orders: the product returns to the Seller, Revibe handles the shipping costs, the Seller is credited 100% of the SKU price initially indicated, and no additional deductions are made.

evidence.quote: '(c) Return to Origin — Seller issue ... AE & ZA Orders — ... Revibe handles the shipping costs and the Seller is credited 100% of the SKU price they initially indicated. No additional deductions will be made from the Seller.'

facts.statement: Every device has a 12-month warranty from the delivery date, covering repair, replacement or refund of products that fail to meet Revibe's quality standards.

evidence.quote: Every device has a 12-month warranty.
'a) Coverage. ... warranty period of 12 months from the delivery date, covering repair, replacement, or refund of Products that fail to meet Revibe's quality standards.'

facts.statement: On the day of delivery, the customer has full coverage, including accidental damage occurring that day.

evidence.quote: 'b) Day of delivery. On the day of delivery, the customer shall benefit from full coverage, including for accidental damage occurring on that day.'

facts.statement: The warranty does not cover: misuse or failure to follow the user manual; physical or accidental damage including broken screens or cracks; water damage or liquid exposure; normal battery wear within the Clause 7.2 thresholds; and LCD issues under Clause 7.6.

evidence.quote: It excludes misuse, physical or water damage, and normal battery wear.

'c) Exclusions. The warranty does not cover: Misuse or failure to comply with the user manual. Physical or accidental damage (including broken screens or cracks). Water damage or exposure to liquids. Normal battery wear and tear ... Clause 7.2. LCD issues, as set out in Clause 7.6.'

facts.statement: For a valid warranty claim on UAE and South Africa orders, the product goes back to the Seller for repair or replacement; Revibe arranges shipping on the Seller's behalf and a fixed AED 30 fee is deducted from the Seller, covering the return shipment and the reshipment to the customer.

evidence.quote: For a valid claim, you repair or replace the device.
In the UAE {and?} South Africa, shipping costs you have fixed 30 dirhams.

'e) Valid claim. ... AE & ZA Orders — The product is returned to the Seller for repair or replacement. Revibe shall arrange the shipping logistics on the Seller's behalf, and a fixed fee of AED 30 shall be deducted from the Seller to cover the cost of both the return shipment and the subsequent reshipment to the customer.'

facts.statement: For a valid warranty claim on KSA orders, the product goes back to the Seller for repair or replacement and the Seller arranges the shipping logistics and related support fees.

evidence.quote: 'SA Orders — The product is returned to the Seller for repair or replacement. The Seller shall arrange the shipping logistics and support related fees.'

facts.statement: For an invalid claim on UAE and South Africa orders where the customer does not pay shipping, Revibe keeps the device and the Seller is not credited anything.

evidence.quote: 'AE & ZA Orders — Revibe keeps the device, the Seller is not credited anything.'

facts.statement: For an invalid claim on KSA orders where the customer does not pay shipping, Revibe keeps the device and the Seller is compensated 20% of the SKU price initially indicated plus AED 150.

evidence.quote: 'SA Orders — Revibe keeps the device, the Seller is compensated 20% of the SKU price they initially indicated plus 150 AED.'

facts.statement: For an invalid claim where the customer pays the shipping charges, the product is returned to the customer.

evidence.quote: 'Customer pays for shipping charges — The product is returned to the Customer.'

facts.statement: A warranty claim must be resolved (repair, replacement or refund, if the product fails the specifications) within 5 working days of Revibe receiving the Product.

evidence.quote: Resolve claims within five working days of receiving the device.
'9.1 a) The warranty shall cover repair, replacement, or refund of the Product within 5 working days from the date of receiving the Product, if it fails to meet the specifications.'

facts.statement: If a warranty claim is still unresolved after 6 working days from receipt of the device, Revibe may issue a full refund to the customer and recover it from the Seller. This applies to non-cooperation or lack of response from the Seller.

evidence.quote: 'b) If any warranty claim remains unresolved after 6 working days from the date of the reception of the device, Revibe reserves the right to issue a full refund to the customer and recover the refunded amount from the Seller. This policy will be applied in cases of non-cooperation or lack of response from the Seller.'

facts.statement: If a warranty claim is still unresolved by the Seller after 8 working days, Revibe issues a full refund to the customer regardless of the reason and recovers the refunded amount from the Seller.

evidence.quote: After eight, Revive refunds the customer at your cost.

'c) If any warranty claim remains unresolved by the Seller after 8 working days, Revibe will issue a full refund to the customer regardless of the reason and recover the refunded amount from the Seller.'

facts.statement: In every country the Seller must receive the returned device and inform Revibe of its reception. Not doing so counts as non-cooperation, so Clause 9.1(b) applies.

evidence.quote: 'd) On all countries, the Seller is responsible to receive the device and inform Revibe about reception. Not taking necessary actions ... would be considered as non-cooperation, hence Clause 9.1(b) shall apply.'

facts.statement: When the Seller marks a claim as invalid, the Seller must provide its rationale and proof supporting that assessment before the invalid-claim re-evaluation (clause 9.2 a, AWB creation).

evidence.quote: '9.2 Invalid Claim Re-evaluation ... a) AWB Creation. Once the Seller marks a claim as invalid, they need to provide rationale and proofs supporting their assessment.'

facts.statement: A product disputed for condition or grading is resolved using Revibe's grading definitions in Clause 7.1; if the product does not meet the grading standards, Revibe may adjust the price, request a replacement, or apply the return policy.

evidence.quote: 'In the event of a dispute regarding the condition or grading of a product, the Parties agree to resolve such matters based on Revibe's established grading definitions set out in Clause 7.1. ... Revibe reserves the right to adjust the price, request a replacement, or apply a return policy as necessary.'

facts.statement: Revibe ships UAE and South Africa orders.

evidence.quote: Revive ships UAE and South Africa orders.
'For UAE and ZA Orders, Revibe will handle the shipping.'

facts.statement: For KSA (Saudi) orders the Seller ships, covers all related charges including customs duties and fees, and must use a Revibe-approved partner so the customer always has a tracking ID.

evidence.quote: Saudi orders are yours to ship, by air, with an approved courier, customs included.

'For KSA Orders, the Seller is responsible for handling the shipping, including covering all related charges such as customs duties and fees. The Seller must use Revibe-approved partners to ensure that there is always a tracking ID for the customer to follow.'

facts.statement: Approved partners for KSA shipments are DHL, UPS, Aramex, SMSA, RSA and Delivery Panda.

evidence.quote: 'Approved partners for KSA shipments include DHL, UPS, Aramex, SMSA, RSA and Delivery Panda.'

facts.statement: Failure to ship a KSA order by air costs the Seller a penalty of 10% of the Order value per non-compliant shipment.

evidence.quote: Saudi orders are yours to ship, by air, with an approved courier, customs included.
'Failure to ship by air will result in a penalty equal to 10% of the Order value per non-compliant shipment'

facts.statement: For KSA orders where the customer pays shipping fees on delivery, Revibe reimburses the customer for the amount paid plus an extra AED 50 goodwill amount, and the total is charged back to the Seller by deduction or separate invoice. This clause applies solely to sales delivered to customers in KSA.

evidence.quote: '10.2 Customer Compensation for Fees (SA Orders only) ... This clause applies solely to sales delivered to customers located in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia ... Revibe shall reimburse the customer for the amount paid, together with an additional 50 AED as a commercial goodwill gesture. The aggregate sum ... shall be charged back to the Seller, either by deduction from amounts owed to the Seller or by separate invoice.'

facts.statement: Always use Revibe's packaging. If the Seller runs out of Revibe packing materials, it must notify Revibe immediately, and until Revibe restocks it may ship with alternative packing.

evidence.quote: Always use Revive's packaging.
{If?} you run out, tell us right away, or it's 200 dirhams per complaint.
'If the Seller runs out of Revibe's packing materials, they must notify Revibe immediately. Until Revibe restocks, the Seller is permitted to ship using alternative packing materials.'

facts.statement: A 200 AED penalty applies to the Seller for each confirmed customer complaint about an order without Revibe's standard packing, when the Seller did not notify Revibe of the packing material shortage or the Seller still had stock of Revibe packing materials.

evidence.quote: {If?} you run out, tell us right away, or it's 200 dirhams per complaint.

'10.6 Non-Compliance Penalty ... it is confirmed that: The Seller did not notify Revibe of the packing material shortage, or The Seller still had stock of Revibe's packing materials, A penalty of 200 AED will be applied to the Seller for each such complaint.'

facts.statement: The Seller must comply with Revibe's quality guidelines (linked from clause 10.7) and run quality check processes in line with them.

evidence.quote: '10.7 Quality guidelines. The Seller agrees to comply with the quality guidelines outlined below and to implement quality check processes in alignment with these standards. Link to quality guidelines'

facts.statement: NSYS is an app for diagnostics of mobile devices. Revibe may require a Seller to use it under Revibe's licence, Revibe supports set-up and training, and the scope of devices tested is limited to iPhones.

evidence.quote: '10.8 NSYS: Revibe reserves the right to oblige a Seller to use NSYS (an app for diagnostics of mobile devices) under Revibe license ... The scope of devices tested is limited to iPhones.'

facts.statement: The Seller must factory reset every device and ensure it is free of personal data before shipping to the customer; the Seller bears full responsibility for this.

evidence.quote: Factory reset every device before shipping.
'The Seller bears full responsibility for ensuring that all devices are completely wiped, reset to factory settings, and free of any personal data prior to shipment to the customer.'

facts.statement: Revibe is not held responsible or liable for any personal or confidential data that remains stored on devices sold through its platform.

evidence.quote: 'Revibe shall not be held responsible or liable for any personal or confidential data that remains stored on the devices sold through its platform.'

facts.statement: If a Seller does not wipe devices as required, the Seller's account may be suspended or terminated, and/or a 50 AED penalty applies at Revibe's discretion.

evidence.quote: 'Failure to comply with this requirement may result in suspension or termination of the Seller's account and/or 50 AED penalty at Revibe's discretion.'

facts.statement: If a customer receives a faulty or missing charger, the customer may raise a compensation claim within ten (10) days of receiving the order. Revibe reviews the evidence and, on approval, refunds the customer and debits the Seller. The process is fully automated.

evidence.quote: 'If a customer receives a faulty or missing charger, they may raise a compensation claim within ten (10) days of receiving the order.' 'This process is fully automated in Revibe's system.'
Missing chargers are refunded to the customer and charged to you, from 30 to 70 dirhams.

facts.statement: Charger compensation values: phone charger (iPhone or Samsung) AED 30; laptop charger AED 50; MacBook charger AED 70.

evidence.quote: 'Compensation values: Phone charger (iPhone / Samsung): 30 AED; MacBook charger: 70 AED; Laptop charger: 50 AED'

facts.statement: Sellers remain accountable for the completeness and quality of the delivered package, including accessories.

evidence.quote: 'This ensures that customers receive all necessary accessories, while Sellers remain accountable for completeness and quality of the delivered package.'

facts.statement: The Seller's score must reflect its operational performance and let it set its price positioning against competitors, in line with the quality and operational excellence it offers. The score ranges from -10% to +10%.

evidence.quote: Your score, from {minus?} 10 to plus 10 percent, reflects your performance.
'11.1 Score principle ... Seller's score may vary between -10% and +10%'

facts.statement: Sellers get access to a Performance and Score sheet detailing their live performance and how their score is calculated.

evidence.quote: 'Sellers get access to a Performance and Score sheet detailing their live performance and how their score is calculated.'

facts.statement: A poor score can lead Revibe to suspend the Seller's account; the Seller can then no longer ship orders independently and must send products to Revibe's warehouse, the only available option, to keep business active in the UAE and South Africa.

evidence.quote: A poor score can suspend your own shipping.
You'd then sell only through Revive's warehouse.
'11.2 ... the Seller shall no longer be permitted to ship orders independently, and the only available option will be to send products to Revibe's warehouse ...'

facts.statement: Either party can terminate the agreement with 30 days' written notice.

evidence.quote: Either side can leave with 30 days notice.
'13.1 This Agreement may be terminated by either Party by providing a 30-day written notice to the other Party.'

facts.statement: After a breach, the non-breaching party may terminate the agreement immediately on written notice.

evidence.quote: '13.2 In the event of a breach of the terms outlined in this Agreement, the non-breaching Party may terminate this Agreement immediately upon written notice.'

facts.statement: After termination, the Seller must fulfil Orders confirmed before the termination notice date and resolve claims received before that date, plus claims arising within 12 months after the last Order delivery.

evidence.quote: {You?} still handle open orders and claims for 12 months

'The Seller shall fulfil all Orders confirmed prior to the date of the termination notice; The Seller shall resolve all Claims received prior to the date of the termination notice, as well as any Claims arising within 12 months following the date of the last Order delivery;'

facts.statement: Revibe settles all amounts due to the Seller within 180 days from the date of the last Order delivery.

evidence.quote: {You?} still handle open orders and claims for 12 months and Revive pays what it owes within 180
days
'Revibe shall settle all amounts due to the Seller within 180 days from the date of the last Order delivery.'

facts.statement: The Seller must keep an active line of communication with Revibe and notify it immediately of stock issues or delays in fulfilling Orders.

evidence.quote: '12.1 The Seller shall maintain an active line of communication with Revibe and notify Revibe immediately if there are any stock issues or delays in fulfilling Orders.'

facts.statement: Questions about the Seller Agreement go to the Seller's Key Account Manager (KAM).

evidence.quote: That's it any question ask your key account manager
Button 'Questions? Ask your Key Account Manager'

terms.meaning: Revibe Technology FZ LLC, the counterparty to the Seller Agreement (incorporated in Dubai Internet City, UAE).
The company that sells its Products through Revibe on commission and fulfils Orders.
The person who answers Seller questions about the agreement (per the recap slide and closing line).
Name Revibe creates for each Seller for internal systems; may be displayed on the website when referencing the Seller as provider of products.
Revibe sells the Seller's products on commission; the Seller fulfils and ships Orders to end customers.
An order that Revibe passes to the Seller to fulfil and ship; Revibe provides order updates through a shared system (3.1, 3.3).
Base amount used for penalties, returns and credits (e.g. 5%, 20%, 100%, 80%).
Cash-on-delivery Orders; invoiced upon delivery to the customer and excluded from the weekly settlement (5.1, 5.4).
The Seller's net balance is the basis for the AED 5,000 withholding threshold (5.5). The AED 10,000 minimum balance is retained from amounts otherwise due (5.6).
Invoice Revibe issues in the Seller's name for VAT purposes; shows VAT separately under the Standard Scheme.
A required tax document the Seller must keep valid.
Two VAT accounting schemes for supplies through Revibe; Option B requires completing Clause 6.15.3.
The four product grades for phones, defined by cosmetic and technical standards and battery health thresholds.
Battery capacity percentage used to grade devices (above 95, 90, 85) and to judge degradation after delivery.
A device message saying the battery or other parts are not original; entitles the customer to a full refund.
Video the Seller must record on receipt of any returned or warranty device; it is the supporting evidence for claims.
Clause 8.1 definitions; Revibe's decision is final when the Seller disagrees.
Return of a device to the Seller, used in the change-of-mind, refusal and seller-issue cases.
12 months from the delivery date for products meeting Revibe's quality standards.
Fee deducted from the Seller for a valid-claim return shipment and reshipment on UAE and South Africa orders.
Used for the 48-hour shipping deadline and the 5, 6 and 8 working-day claim timelines; the agreement does not define them on the frames seen.
Air waybill that the Revibe Operations Claims team generates in the invalid-claim re-evaluation process (clause 9.2).
UAE (United Arab Emirates, AE on some screens), ZA (South Africa) and KSA (Kingdom of Saudi Arabia). Clause 7.7 spells out ZA as South Africa and KSA as Saudi Arabia.
Couriers the Seller must use for KSA shipments: DHL, UPS, Aramex, SMSA, RSA and Delivery Panda.
App for diagnostics of mobile devices that Revibe may require Sellers to use under Revibe's licence (iPhone scope).
Seller performance figure from -10% to +10%, reflecting operational performance and price positioning.
Sheet that gives the Seller its live performance and shows how its score is calculated.
Duties that survive termination: open Orders, Claims received before notice, and Claims within 12 months after the last Order delivery.
Know-Your-Customer and anti-money-laundering checks the Seller must pass.

unclear.issue: The phrase '{So,?} never issue ... a duplicate' is unreliable and no frame shows it. The rule it refers to is only implied; see the low-confidence 'Implied:' fact.

'Report any change within 7 days' for the VAT scheme is said by the trainer but the 7-day period is not shown on any frame. Clause 5.10 on screen says 'promptly ... without undue delay' for documents. Check the full agreement before relying on the 7 days.
Trainer says customers can return 'for any reason'. Screen clause 8.2 says 'for any valid reason, including change of mind or product issues'. The fact uses the screen wording.

Trainer says 'shipping costs you have fixed 30 dirhams' with no context. Screen shows the AED 30 fee only for a valid-claim return and reshipment on UAE and ZA orders (warranty e). Not confirmed that it applies in any other case.

Trainer's '{You?} still handle open orders and claims for 12 months' is consistent with clause 13.3, but the 12-month window applies to claims arising after the last Order delivery, not to all open work. The wording on screen is precise.
Recap slide says '48h shipping', but clause 3.4 says 'within 48 working hours of receiving an Order'. The slide drops 'working'. The agreement wording governs; do not tell Sellers 48 calendar hours.
Parent clause numbers for the return-to-origin sub-clauses (b) and (c) are not visible. The SA line under (c) is not visible on the frame, so the seller-issue rule for KSA orders is not shown.
Clause 9.2 (invalid claim re-evaluation, AWB creation) is cut off after step (a). The rest of the process (who does what, and when) is not visible.
Clause 5.8 (bank rejection) and 5.11 (right to withhold payment) are cut off on the frames. Only the visible text is recorded.
The lead-in sentence for the battery degradation bullets in clause 7.2 is cut off. The 3%-in-10-days bullet is visible but its introduction is not, and the trainer does not mention it.
The quality guidelines link under clause 10.7 is only partly legible at frame resolution. The exact URL is not recorded here; take it from the agreement itself.
